description: Pass a URL and get the page as clean text — furniture (nav, scripts, ads, footers) stripped, paragraphs preserved — plus its title, description and site name. The step every agent needs before it can reason about a page, and the one most agents can't do themselves: serverless runtimes and MCP clients have no browser and no HTML parser. Follows redirects safely, refuses non-text content, caps at 2 MB. Nothing crypto about it.
name: url_extract
